text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...*pant*... *gasp*... *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"—Sei! Haa!
Fu! Taa!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: âBEGONE!!" hisses!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-dono,
I look forward to receiving your guidance today as well!
choice_data_list: First, let's start with pace running.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ossu!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: HAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, gasp*...
choice_data_list: That's the end of today's menu!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes... If you will permit me,
I would like to stay behind and train on my own.
choice_data_list: Understood. Report to me on your training details later

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(That "obsession" I cannot reach...
I still do not know how to bring it forth.)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(However, the way Chiyono O-san and
Ardan-san ran beyond their limits.
That driving force was likely "obsession.")

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (If so, then perhaps by pushing myself to the limit, I might finally grasp that "obsession"...)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Pushing oneself to the absolute extreme.
...For now, I must stay the course with that strategy...!

On my way home after finishing up my paperwork,
I stopped by the track.
Sure enough, Yaeno Muteki was still running.

I'm being careful not to overdo it,
but it's still not in very good shape.

Above all, she seemed mentally strained.
It would probably be best to give her a change of pace—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, it's pretty packed!
There's still plenty of time before
the main event, the Tenno Sho (Autumn), starts, right?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's bound to be paying attention.
After all, it might turn out to be a historic race!

Today, I invited Yaeno Muteki
to watch the Tenno Sho (Autumn) with me.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Who do you think's gonna win?
My money's on Tamamo Cross!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Come on, it's gotta be Oguri Cap!
You just know you want to see her claim her first GⅠ title!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: The level of attention they're getting is truly incredible, Tamamo-san and Oguri-san.
choice_data_list: They're calling it the Summit Showdown, huh.
They're calling it the Summit Showdown, huh.

text_block_list.text: A direct showdown between Tamamo Cross, continuing her unstoppable streak, and Oguri Cap.

Their relationship of viewing each other as rivals
could be said to be similar to that of
Yaeno Muteki and Sakura Chiyono O.

That's why I invited you to watch, hoping
that Oguri Cap and the others' race
might give you a clue.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"I suspect we will have chances to face each other
on the track in the future.
Allow me to study both of you thoroughly."

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek! Ogriii!!
Good luck out thereee!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross,
go blow 'em all away again today!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: What an absolute crucible of boiling excitement...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: In the midst of this frenzy, Tamamo-san and Oguri-san are...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: It's the perfect stage, ain't it, Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Let's see which of us is stronger—
which of us is the "strongest."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Let's settle the score once and for all in this race!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...I've never really thought about
being the "strongest."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I want to beat Tama. I will beat Tama. That's all there is to it.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (Oguri's vibe... is different from the Mainichi Hai...?)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Under 200m to go! Tamamo Cross takes the lead!
Will it be Oguri Cap or Tamamo Cross?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna tear right through all the way to the finish line!!
Doryaaaaaaaah!"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
—Right here, right now!!
HAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And now, Oguri Cap is closing in!
Tamamo Cross tries to break away! Tamamo Cross is holding on!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Win, win, I'm going to beat Tama!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap just can't reach!
Tamamo Cross! Tamamo Cross takes 1st place!
(Woooooaaaaahhhhhh!)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Haha! We did it! We won!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Ngh... I won't lose next time...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: What's up? Plannin' on challenging me to a rematch?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. As many times as it takes until I beat Tama!
I want to beat Tama!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Sure thing. Come at me as many times as you like!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Oguri-san is...
Oguri-san's "obsession" is...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: "I want to beat Tamamo-san."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...I see...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no...... It was a meaningful watch.
I must also dedicate myself in preparation for the Osaka Hai.

Yaeno Muteki smiled as she said that.
However, the heavy air about her made me wonder
if it was just my imagination...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ..."Obsession," huh...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(I'd assumed that Oguri-san, in her state of selfless clarity,
was entirely free from 'attachments.')

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (However...)

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. As many times as it takes until I beat Tama!
I want to beat Tama!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (That is, without a doubt, pure "obsession.")

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(Though devoid of raging fury,
my feelings fly true like an arrow loosed.)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (Oguri too. And Chiyono O. And Ardan.)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(They've elevated their feelings toward their goal
into sheer 'obsession.')

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (I'm the only one falling behind...!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—Trainer-dono told me.
Even without an "obsession," one can still grow strong.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: However, how much of a gap lies between her and those driven by "obsession"...?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to yield. I want the strength to overcome the strong
and show Gramps and the others just how much I've grown...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Strong feelings reside right here in my heart!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: What is it that's missing to reach “obsession”...!
